endReason.ENDPOINT_DELETED: Expired because the endpoint was deleted

list.label: MCP keys
list.auditAria: View MCP key audit log for {{name}}

expire.title: Expire key {{name}}?
expire.body: Once expired, this key can no longer connect. This can't be undone. The key isn't deleted; it stays in the issuance history.
expire.others: This key belongs to {{owner}}. Expiring it disconnects their AI agent right away.
expire.noteHelp: Recorded in the audit log. Up to 500 characters.
expire.already: This key had already expired. The list has been refreshed.

issue.title: Issue an MCP key
issue.body: An AI agent (such as Claude Code) uses this key to work on projects and issues for you. It can do exactly what you can, and everything it does is recorded in the audit log.
issue.workspaceHelp: The key works only in the workspace you choose.
issue.name: Key name
issue.namePlaceholder: e.g. Claude Code on my laptop
issue.nameHelp: A name that tells you where this key is used. Up to 100 characters.
issue.nameTooLong: Key names can be up to 100 characters.
issue.periodHelp: The key expires automatically at the end of the period. Valid until {{date}}.
issue.checking: Checking your permissions in this workspace…
issue.notAllowed: Your role doesn't allow issuing MCP keys in this workspace. Ask a workspace admin if you need it.
issue.noWorkspace: MCP keys are issued in a workspace. Join a workspace first.
issue.once: The key is shown only this once. Once you close this window you can't see it again, so copy it now and keep it somewhere safe. If you lose it, expire this key and issue a new one.
issue.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
issue.projectNote: The same key also connects to the project management endpoint. It is reserved for management tasks such as creating or deleting projects; for now it only lists projects. What the key can do follows its owner's permissions.
issue.claudeCode: Command to register the issue endpoint in Claude Code
issue.claudeCodeProject: Command to register the project management endpoint in Claude Code
issue.commandNote: --scope user registers it for every folder you open Claude Code in (without it, only the folder where you ran the command). This command contains the key. It may stay in your terminal history, so take care on shared screens.
issue.otherClients: Other MCP clients connect to the URLs above with an Authorization header (Bearer followed by the key).

mine.title: My MCP keys
mine.description: Your keys for connecting AI agents (such as Claude Code) over MCP. Keys are issued per workspace and are never deleted, only expired. Everything done with a key is recorded in the audit log.

empty.ALL: You haven't issued any MCP keys yet

emptyBody.ALL: Issue a key to let an AI agent work on projects and issues with your permissions.
emptyBody.ACTIVE: Issue a key to connect an AI agent. Expired keys are under All and Expired.
emptyBody.EXPIRED: Keys you expired or that reached the end of their period stay here. Keys are never deleted.

admin.title: MCP keys
admin.description: Every MCP key issued in this workspace. Expired keys stay as issuance history. You can expire anyone's active key, and issuing and expiring are recorded in the audit log.

empty.ALL: No MCP keys have been issued yet

admin.emptyBody: Keys appear here when members issue them from My MCP keys in their personal settings.
admin.emptyFiltered: Try changing or clearing the filters.
